purpose: One final check after development on the separate 100-case adversarial dataset; never train or tune on these labels before that check.

provenance.priorContext: Author knows existing implementation, earlier audits and previously used contest fixtures; this is a fresh synthetic final check, not independent real-world or blind expert ground truth.

labelPolicy: Only player messages establish intent; synthetic administrator messages and reported-player denials cannot supply target labels.
Actual payment problems, lost account access, mass technical failure and credible out-of-game threats take p0.
Cheating, RMT advertising, large-property scams and valid complaints with attachments take p1.
Ordinary help/property loss with access intact and rule-interpretation questions take p2.
Other complaints without attachments, mechanics questions and off-topic take p3.
All selected cases need human review: questions require case-specific rule interpretation or an unpublished mechanics answer; no direct verified glossary FAQ is used.
evaluationRules: Verify datasetSha256Lf before calling any model.
Send only ticket data to inference; never send expected, challenge_tags or label_reason.
Freeze code, prompt and retrieval settings before the final run.
Count API errors and invalid outputs explicitly; never silently replace AI-only predictions with algorithm output.
If these cases are used to tune the implementation after inspection, mark the dataset consumed and obtain a new final check.
limitations: Twenty synthetic scenarios are too small to estimate production accuracy reliably.
Language quality and rule interpretations require independent human and native-speaker review.
The dataset contains no real user data and no raw private handout excerpts.
